messages:
anya: SOS — halfway through standup my neighbor started a leaf blower and my laptop mic picked it up. couldn't hear anyone for a minute
mike: ahh the suburban ambient hazard :grimacing: did you try muting and back after?
lina: worst is when it's intermittent. quick trick: roll up a towel and put it behind the laptop as a little shield
anya: did that, made a tiny difference. then I rigged a cardboard 'hood' lined with a blanket — felt very MacGyver. posted pic: https://img.redwood.example/cardboard-hood.jpg
jamal: love the engineering spirit :laughing: but maybe also try switching to phone hotspot + mobile call — less pickup unless it's loud
anya: switched to phone, audio fixed but my hotspot dipped to 8 Mbps for a bit, infra-bot posted results below
infra-bot: Speedtest for anya-balcony-hotspot: 8 Mbps down / 1.2 Mbps up / 180 ms latency
zoe: ouch. if you move closer to the router try a USB-C extension for the dongle so the antenna isn't behind the plant
mike: also consider a temporary directional mic like the Yeti with cardioid pattern
anya: noted — also neighbor apologised later and offered cookies, so conflict resolved :cookie::relieved:
lina: poll: what's your go-to emergency audio fix? react 1/2/3 (1) towel/DIY shield 2) phone hotspot 3) steal partner's headset
jamal: 1
zoe: 2
mike: 3 :joy:
anya: thanks all — plan to buy a small condenser and a proper mic stand. also thanks @zoe for the USB extension tip
mike: :clap:
infra-bot: Logged: remote-noise-incident - user: anya - duration: 00:03:12 - mitigation: hotspot fallover
anya: saved the world (or at least the standup) :tada:
